text: {"lessons":["I should use a clear plan for each holding: selling Stock A at a loss and later buying it back at a higher price shows the cost of reacting without a consistent thesis.","I should size positions and keep enough cash to handle volatility; repeated trades and large sales can change my exposure quickly.","I should judge decisions over the long run against the market, not just recent account gains or whether a trade was profitable, and review what drove each result."]}
